I have implemented the `slugify` helper function in [`textkit/slug.py`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-j6mhwsdu/repo/textkit/slug.py).

### Summary of Changes:
- **`textkit/slug.py`**: Added `slugify(text, sep="-")` which converts `text` to lowercase, replaces sequences of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with `sep`, and strips any leading or trailing separators.
- **`tests/test_slug.py`**: Added unit tests covering default behavior, custom separators, alphanumeric strings, runs of special characters, and edge cases.
